issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

webpackMode.description:
The webpack mode to use when bundling. If not set, fall back based on the App mode:
return 'development' for 'dev' and 'test' App mode, or 'production' for 'prod' and 'trial' mode.

bundlerMaxMem.description: The maximum memory to use when bundling. Default is 4096.

handler.description: The handler used to switch between Configs when bundling.

title:
WebpackBundlerConfig provides the information for the webpack bundling Configurations when UiSdlConfig does not exist.
This is used when uiBundler is a dependent package and users do not want to include uiInfrastructure as a dependent package.
name: WebpackBundlerConfig
